choices.background: Every step forward, the same thought came back: turn around.
I lied to bring her here. Out here, it still sounds like a lie.
This is the memory I keep repeating. Her version belongs here, too.
I was certain I knew. Now I hear what I do not remember.
I held on because I was afraid. I can hear the rest now.
One cup, then one cup again. I thought it was just how we lived.
She packed for both of us. I never knew she kept doing that.
An open door. I still cannot tell which of us it was for.
I saw her. She saw me. The quiet stayed between us.
Two cups. She put out two cups before I came back.
I am sorry. The words are true, even if they are late.
She was waiting at the door. I keep seeing that now.
She answered. It came back in my own voice.
My handwriting. I know every turn of it, and none of what it says.
I wrote her name. The trees gave it back to me.
The prints end where I stopped looking.
Only a coat. I was afraid of the shape I gave it.
What is she? The question feels smaller than what she just asked.
Beside her. This time, we both know which way we are going.
She can stay. I can keep the lantern lit from here.
